# S0061: HDoor

<a id="s0061"></a>

Type: malware  
ATT&CK: [S0061](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0061)  
Platforms: Windows  
Aliases: Custom HDoor  

[HDoor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0061) is malware that has been customized and used by the [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019) group.
